question: How is the seat declared in its ninefold inner and outer arrangement?
premises: Puṇḍravardhana and Vārendra, and likewise Ekāmra, are included externally.
The seat has been declared in nine ways.
This ninefold division follows an inner and outer sequence.
inference: The seat is taught as a ninefold structure organized by an inner-to-outer sequence, incorporating Puṇḍravardhana, Vārendra, and Ekāmra externally.
uncertainties: The exact enumeration of all nine divisions is distributed across verses and not fully explicit here.
plain_english: With Puṇḍravardhana and Vārendra, and likewise Ekāmra, included externally, that seat has been declared in nine ways, in an inner and outer sequence.
